attributes.board_name: Nevada State Board of Medical Examiners

rules.unit: hours (AMA PRA Category 1 or Board approved)
rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA PRA Category 1 or NSBME Board approved; at least 20 of the 40 hours within the licensee's scope of practice/specialty
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prorated by initial licensure date in the 2025-2027 cycle: licensed Jan-Jun 2026 = 30 h, Jul-Dec 2026 = 20 h, Jan-Jun 2027 = 10 h (always at least 2 h ethics/pain/addiction).
rules.alternatives: ABMS certification/recertification certificates may count for the AMA PRA Category 1 hours they state (NAC 630.153). CME not required for inactive licensees.
rules.audit_note: Attest to all required CE at each renewal; licensees selected in the renewal CME audit must provide proof.

topics.who: All licensees: 2 hours in ethics, pain management or addiction care each biennium
SBIRT (Screening, Brief Intervention and Referral to Treatment), within 2 years of initial licensure
Licensees registered to dispense controlled substances: misuse and abuse of controlled substances, opioid prescribing or addiction
All licensees: within 2 years of initial licensure, then every 4 years
Psychiatrists only: cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion

MDs providing or supervising emergency medical services in a hospital or primary care: stigma, discrimination and unrecognized bias toward persons with or at high risk of HIV, within 2 years of starting such care

rules.notes: Up to 4 hours double credit for geriatrics/gerontology, medication management or rare disease diagnosis (incl. pediatric cancer). NAC 630 (read 2026-10-28) states no MD renewal date: CME is due by the final date the Board sets for biennial registration (NAC 630.153).

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 10 credits AOA Category 1-A or AMA Category 1 per year; remaining credits provider choice

topics.who: Annually: misuse and abuse of controlled substances, opioid prescribing or addiction
In even years: ethics, pain management, care of persons with addiction or SBIRT
SBIRT approach to substance use disorder, within 2 years of initial licensure
Within 2 years of licensure, then every 4 years
Psychiatrists: cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion, biennially
DOs providing or supervising emergency medical services in a hospital or primary care (effective Jan 1, 2024), within 2 years of starting such care

rules.notes: DOs are licensed by the Nevada State Board of Osteopathic Medicine (bom.nv.gov). Board table: 35 credits annually. Renewal date and reporting method not stated on the CME page.
